paragraphs: Rav Chana of Carthage, in R. Yehoshua ben Levi's time; see Rav Acha above. Yuchasin also lists R. Chanina of Carthage before R. Yehoshua ben Levi; they are all one. Jerusalem Beitzah, chapter 1, halakhah 5, and Shabbat, chapter 16, halakhah 2: “R. Yaakov bar Acha said: R. Chinena of Carthage said: R. Hoshaya said.”
